messages.markdown:
# Holiday Gifting & Early Black Friday Video Intelligence

Across 322 fully scored short-form videos (median: 11,171 views) spanning home, fashion, and beauty, five findings define high-performing Q4 creative:

1. **Recipient framing lifts reach 3.5x:** 29.8% (96 of 322) explicitly name a recipient such as a host, partner, or coworker. Recipient-targeted videos posted median views of 24,590 versus 7,060 for untargeted videos.
2. **Packaging is the dominant visual hook:** 59.3% (191 of 322) show the box, wrapping, or unboxing on camera, confirming premium presentation as the core creative driver for gift sets.
3. **Price caps anchor conversion:** 32.4% (103 of 322) state a price, an under-$50 or under-$100 cap, or a holiday discount. These value-anchored videos posted median views of 6,028, consistent with targeted conversion rather than broad virality.
4. **Urgency remains low-saturation whitespace:** Only 15.6% (50 of 322) use countdowns, deadlines, limited stock, or early-access lines, leaving clear headroom for pre-BFCM flash offers.
5. **In-use demos hold steady:** 30.5% (97 of 322) show products applied, worn, or styled on camera, posting median views of 11,739, slightly above the 11,072 median for static displays.

prompts.label: Pick three offers to test before Black Friday
prompts.prompt: From this research, pick the three holiday offers we should test before Black Friday and explain why each one works.

response.markdown:
Test these three offers before Black Friday:

**1. Recipient-framed gift guide.** Naming the recipient lifted reach 3.5x: 29.8% of videos named a host, partner, or parent, with median 24,590 views vs 7,060 untargeted. Copy @tarashopshere (1,433,713 views) and @justrachelv (916,904 views): open with "gifts for the host" then show 3 picks.

**2. Under-$50 / under-$100 bundle.** Price caps appeared in 32.4% of videos and remove hesitation while lifting order value. Test one hero set at each cap like @curatedbybrittney (96,614 views) and @bkharthun (490,726 views).

**3. Unboxing plus early-access urgency.** Packaging led at 59.3%, but urgency sat at only 15.6%, so pair them: film the ribbon reveal, then add "early access ends Sunday." See @staged.by.ana (503,648 views) and @zuziapas_ (1,263,018 views).

prompts.label: Plan a four-week November calendar
prompts.prompt: Turn the strongest gift-guide angles from this research into a four-week content calendar for November.

response.markdown:
**November gift-guide calendar** (from 322 scored videos):

**Week 1 — Recipient guides.** Open with "for the host / for him" — naming recipients hit 29.8% of videos at 24,590 median views vs 7,060 untargeted. Post like @tarashopshere (1,433,713 views) and @justrachelv (916,904 views): 3 picks per recipient, link in bio.

**Week 2 — Unboxing reveals.** Packaging led at 59.3%. Film ribbon + box first, like @staged.by.ana (503,648 views) and @alirosegray (638,100 views).

**Week 3 — Under-$50 / $100 bundles.** Price caps ran in 32.4%. Copy @curatedbybrittney (96,614 views) and @bkharthun (490,726 views).

**Week 4 — Early-access urgency.** Only 15.6% used it. Add "ends Sunday" to the winner, like @zuziapas_ (1,263,018 views).

prompts.label: Compare home, fashion and beauty
prompts.prompt: Compare the winning gifting angles for home, fashion and beauty in this research. What does each category do differently?

response.markdown:
**Home** wins on recipient framing: hostess and host gifts name the recipient and show the box in the room. Copy @staged.by.ana (503,648 views) and @justrachelv (916,904 views): "for the host," then style the candle, vase, or board on the table.

**Beauty** wins on unboxing plus demo: 59.3% show packaging, 30.5% swatch or apply on camera. Lead with the pouch reveal, then swatch. See @tarashopshere (1,433,713 views), @zuziapas_ (1,263,018 views), and @jessicanlinn (689,319 views).

**Fashion** wins on price caps: 32.4% anchor under $50 or $100. Show the try-on, then flash the cap. Use @curatedbybrittney (96,614 views) and @bkharthun (490,726 views).

sections.title: Top videos
sections.why: The 40 highest-performing short-form videos combining strong organic reach, direct holiday and gifting angles, and clear viewer next steps.

sections.title: Gift guides sorted by recipient
sections.why: Products clearly grouped by who they are for, from hosts and partners to coworkers and parents, making catalogue segmentation effortless to reproduce.

sections.title: Unboxing and packaging reveals
sections.why: The box, wrapping ribbons, and unboxing reveals carry the creative storytelling for premium home, beauty, and holiday gift sets.

sections.title: Early Black Friday countdowns
sections.why: Early-access announcements, limited inventory warnings, and countdown hooks that drive high conversion before peak holiday retail rush.

sections.title: Bundles framed around a price cap
sections.why: Gift sets and multi-packs anchored under $50 or $100 price thresholds to eliminate buyer hesitation while lifting average order value.
